pick.name: Google Trends
pick.what: Relative search interest by region/time, related queries, rising topics
pick.why: Free, no account, India + global comparison in one view; enough to judge direction of demand before you have a site.
pick.free_limits: Free; shows relative 0-100 interest, not absolute volume

alts.name: Ahrefs Free (Webmaster Tools + free keyword generator)
alts.what: Free SEO data for sites you verify plus a free keyword idea generator
alts.why: Best free absolute-volume-ish data once you have a live domain.
alts.free_limits: Verified sites only: Site Audit 5,000 crawl credits/mo, Site Explorer up to 1,000 backlinks/keywords, Web Analytics 1M events. Keywords Explorer and competitor analysis are paid

alts.name: Google Keyword Planner
alts.what: Google Ads keyword ideas and volume estimates
alts.why: Only free source of Google's own volume ranges; needs an Ads account with billing info.
alts.free_limits: Needs a Google Ads account with billing details; volumes are estimates/ranges

candidates.name: Ahrefs Free
candidates.verdict: alt once you own a site

candidates.name: Google Search Console
candidates.verdict: free, post-launch: real queries for your own site

candidates.name: Ubersuggest
candidates.verdict: pricing page blocked; limited free searches (unverified)

decision: Trends answers 'is this growing and where' for free; Ahrefs Free and Search Console take over once there is a site. Pay for Ahrefs/Semrush only if SEO becomes a main acquisition channel.

verify.note: Google Trends free, relative 0-100 index. Ahrefs alt numbers all confirmed.
